svg.text: Mandatory Integrity Control (MIC)
Integrity Level (IL) is an extra SID in the token + label in the object's SACL. Default policy = NoWriteUp.
Protected (S-1-16-20480) RID = 0x5000
reserved for Protected Process / WinTcb. Regular apps can't access.
OS services, System processes, user-mode drivers (SYSTEM token).
admin "itvated" process (UAC consent). Can write to HKLM, Program Files.
default for standard users / admin withort itvation. Most interactive apps.
Medium Plus (S-1-16-8448) RID = 0x2100
variant used in normal UAC (between Medium and High).
Internet Explorer Protected Mode, Adobe Reader sandbox, AppContainer (always ≤ Low).
Untrusted (S-1-16-0) RID = 0x0000
more restrictive sandboxes — no write to nearly anything.
Mandatory Policy (TOKEN_MANDATORY_POLICY_*)
NO_WRITE_UP (default) — process cannot write to object with higher IL
NEW_PROCESS_MIN — child process token gets min(parent IL, exe IL)
Mandatory Label ACE in SACL: AceFlags with SYSTEM_MANDATORY_LABEL_NO_WRITE_UP / NO_READ_UP / NO_EXECUTE_UP
